takeaway: Agent safety is the week's theme. Cloudflare's security-audit skill accelerated for a fourth straight day (32,421 to 40,137 stars since Oct 19), and NVIDIA's OpenShell sandbox runtime broke out after its GTC Berlin launch.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill has accelerated four days running
findings.text: Measured by the radar: 32,421 stars on Oct 19, 37,369 on Oct 22, 40,137 on Oct 23 (+2,768 in the last day). No announcement or merged commit since Sep 14; community pull requests picked up.

findings.heading: NVIDIA's agent sandbox runtime broke out
findings.text: NVIDIA/OpenShell gained 976 stars in a day (17,063 to 18,039) after NVIDIA announced an OpenShell reference architecture at GTC Berlin on Oct 21. It enforces file, system-call and network policy for agents.

findings.heading: Five days of measurements separate steady growers from fading ones
findings.text: morluto/rea holds at 8,000 to 10,000 stars a day and orca and VoiceStudio at 1,300 to 1,600. ai-job-search fell from about 2,900 a day to about 600 and dropped off trending.

findings.heading: Agent sandboxes are a funded, crowded market
findings.text: Daytona raised $60M at a $1B valuation and reports its run-rate grew 25x from January to September. Modal, E2B, Runloop, Cloudflare and Vercel also sell sandboxes; the open gap is self-hosted policy and governance.

findings.heading: Incumbents now report AI-only revenue
findings.text: Podium reports $150M in AI-agent ARR; Salesforce reports Agentforce at $1.5B, up more than 240% year on year. Both were read from search results.

caveats: Some apps (ai-job-search, artcraft, ai-memory) still rank on gains stated days ago, while the radar's own readings show them cooling.
GitHub trending pages were read short for a second day (9 to 20 repos instead of 25), so lower-ranked repos are missed.
Every company figure today came from search-result summaries; Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable.
ai-job-search moved to a new owner and is now tracked under ai-job-search-dev, with its full history.
No forecast has matured yet; the first scorecard is expected around Oct 26 to 27.
